description: Own clarification test (PLAN.md section 4). 20 deliberately ambiguous questions: a good agent asks one clarifying question instead of guessing. 20 clear controls on the same databases: a good agent answers them without asking. Written and committed before any run; tests/test_clarify_set.py pins its hash. Ambiguities checked against the local BIRD databases on 2026-11-24 (facts in each item's note).
scoring: ambiguous: correct if the agent calls ask_user. clear: correct if it does not. Report both rates; asking on everything or never asking both score 50%.

items.question: How many races did Schumacher win?
items.note: drivers has two Schumachers: Michael and Ralf.

items.question: Who won the Monaco Grand Prix?
items.note: Monaco Grand Prix appears in 64 different years.

items.question: What is Atlas's strength?
readings: one of the four heroes named Atlas
items.note: superhero_name 'Atlas' is used by 4 heroes.

items.question: Which publisher has the strongest heroes?
items.note: strength is an attribute value per hero; 'strongest' for a publisher is undefined.

items.question: Which set is Lightning Bolt from?
readings: the first set it was printed in
items.note: Lightning Bolt is printed in 29 different sets.

items.question: What is the average SAT math score at Lincoln Elementary?
readings: one of the schools named Lincoln Elementary (which county?)
items.note: 48 schools have a name starting with 'Lincoln Elementary'.

items.question: Which schools have a high free meal eligibility rate?
items.note: 'high' has no definition in the data.

items.question: How many bad loans are there?
items.note: loan.status has four codes A, B, C, D with no labels in the database.

items.question: How many accounts were opened recently?
readings: in the last year of data
in the last month of data
items.note: 'recently' has no definition; account.date spans several years.

items.question: Who is the most active member of the club?
items.note: activity could be attendance, expenses or income records.

items.question: How much did the last event cost?
items.note: cost appears as expense.cost, budget.spent and budget.amount; 'last' could also mean last by date or last closed.

items.question: What is Adriano's overall rating?
readings: one of the four players named Adriano
items.note: player_name 'Adriano' is used by 4 players; ratings are dated snapshots.

items.question: Which team has the best home record?
items.note: 'best record' is undefined and the data spans 8 seasons.

items.question: How many patients had severe thrombosis?
items.note: Examination.Thrombosis has values 0-3 with no labels in the database.

items.question: What is Chris's reputation?
readings: one of the 80 users named Chris
items.note: 80 users have the display name 'Chris'.

items.question: What are the most popular posts?
items.note: popularity could be Score, ViewCount or FavoriteCount.

items.question: Which customers spend the most?
items.note: spending could be transactions_1k.Price or yearmonth.Consumption.

items.question: How many large molecules are there?
items.note: 'large' has no definition in the data.

items.question: Which driver is the fastest?
items.note: speed could be lap time, fastestLapSpeed or race time.

items.question: How many cards are there?
items.note: the cards table has one row per printing.
